sens_en: to throw, to toss, to abandon
origine_fr: Pour s'en souvenir : la main 扌, puis 九, neuf, et 力, la force. La main met toute sa force pour lancer loin, puis lâche : jeter, abandonner, 抛弃. Aucune partie ne se lit pāo.
origine_en: To remember it: the hand 扌, then 九, nine, and 力, strength. The hand puts all its strength into a long throw, then lets go: to throw, to abandon, 抛弃. No part is read pāo.

mots.en: to set aside, to cast off

phrase.pinyin: Tā bǎ qiú pāo gěi le wǒ.
phrase.en: He tossed the ball to me.
